parsed.faithful: All land which is not naturally barren, and is cultivated with any care, affords something more than is necessary to pay the expense of labouring it. This surplus goes as a rent to the landlord, who, in consideration of receiving it without risk or trouble, relinquishes to the farmer the profits of cultivation.
